Home.title: Your direct route to your next job in Europe.
Home.subtitle: Move abroad without worrying about where to live or how to get there.

experience.rest: Some offers don’t ask for it.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.body: Your experience, your English and what you need to move. From your phone, in minutes.

verify.title: Verify your papers
verify.body: A person reviews your ID and CV once, and every agency can see you.

hired.title: Get hired
hired.body: Agencies offer you work. You decide who gets to see your documents.

privacy.title: What an agency sees about you, and what it does not
privacy.hook: Not a promise made in good faith: a permission the agency does not have.
privacy.intro: Your contact details and your documents live in tables an agency has no read permission on. The restriction is enforced in the database, not on the screen.
privacy.example: Example · how the talent pool shows you
privacy.displayNote: Your first name and the initial of your surname. Nothing else.
privacy.neverTitle: What it does not see without your permission
never: Full surname, email and phone number
IBAN, postal address and date of birth
ID card, passport, CV, driving licence, tax identification
privacy.nothingAsked: And there are details {brand} does not even ask you for today: no IBAN, no postal address, no phone number.

support.title: You don’t arrive alone
support.hook: What happens the day you get there

agent.title: An agent, with a name
agent.body: When an agency picks you, you are not writing to an inbox: you get a person assigned to you, who is there through your arrival and while you work with the agency.

arrival.title: The trip is arranged with them
arrival.body: The journey and the first day are prepared with your agent. In some cases they pick you up at the airport or at a point the two of you agree on.

paperwork.title: Paperwork takes hours, not weeks
paperwork.body: Same day. In some offers you are handed the company vehicle right there; in others they take you straight to your accommodation.

pay.title: And you get paid soon
pay.body: Some offers pay weekly and others pay monthly.

support.note: This is how agency work runs in Germany. What applies to you depends on the offer and on the agency that picks you.

faq.title: What you are wondering
faq.hook: Six answers, including the uncomfortable ones.

cost.a: Nothing, and it is not a launch offer: charging a candidate for access to a job is prohibited in the European Union. No commission on your wage, no subscription, no paying to feature your profile. {brand} charges nobody today: there is no payment gateway at all. The day there is one, the agency is who pays.

who.q: Who hires me, {brand} or the agency?
who.a: The agency hires you: it signs your contract and it pays you. {brand} is not a temp agency nor a placement agency, it hires nobody and it is not party to any employment contract. What it does is put you in front of the agency.

eu.q: Do I need an EU passport?
eu.a: Yes. It is a requirement, not a preference: these offers are for people who can work in the European Union without a work permit, with the passport or ID card of an EU country. English, on the other hand, depends on each offer.

travel.q: Who pays for the trip and the accommodation?
travel.a: You pay for the trip. And the accommodation, when the offer includes it, is not a gift: it is deducted straight from your wage. An offer saying “with accommodation” means the agency finds it and fronts it for you, not that it comes free.

pay.a: It depends on the agency: some offers pay weekly and others pay monthly.

data.q: What do agencies see about me?
data.a: Your profile without your full surname and without any way to contact you, and nothing more until you give a specific agency permission.
